welcome:
✨ *Welcome to Feed Me Bible!* ✨

I'm here to help you read through scripture at your own pace.

Let's get you set up!
choose_commitment:
📖 Choose your commitment level (1-5):

*Level 1* — 1 reading track
*Level 2* — 2 reading tracks
*Level 3* — 3 reading tracks
*Level 4* — 4 reading tracks
*Level 5* — 5 reading tracks
commitment_set:
✅ Commitment level set to *{{level}}*.
You have *{{level}}* active reading slot(s).
choose_delivery_time:
⏰ When would you like to receive your daily reading?

Send me a time like `07:00` or `20:30`.
setup_complete:
🎉 *You're all set!*

Use /read to get today's reading.
Use /settings to change your preferences.
Use /help for all commands.
help:
📚 *Feed Me Bible — Commands*

/start — Start or restart onboarding
/read — Get your current reading
/next — Advance to the next reading
/settings — View and change preferences
/language — Switch language
/streak — View your reading streak
/help — Show this help message
settings_menu:
⚙️ *Settings*

🌍 Language: *{{language}}*
📖 Commitment Level: *{{level}}*
⏰ Delivery Time: *{{time}}*
🕐 Timezone: *{{timezone}}*
no_active_tracks:
You don't have any active reading tracks yet.
Use /start to set up your first track!
streak_info:
🔥 *Your Reading Streak*

📅 Current: *{{current}}* days
🏆 Longest: *{{longest}}* days
📖 Last read: *{{lastDate}}*
invalid_time: ❌ Please send a valid time in HH:MM format (e.g. `07:00`).
error_generic: ❌ Something went wrong. Please try again.
